observations: Three photos show a hand holding two black smartphones with dual-camera setups, consistent with iPhone 12 design.
Each phone has a white sticker with a barcode on the back, covering part of the camera module.
The phones are held in front of a wall with a 'SEADOT GROUP' logo and slogan 'Sincerity Is Pride'.
Photo 1 shows a glass display cabinet with other electronics, including boxed phones and a laptop.
No screen, front, or side views of the phones are visible.
No text or branding is legible on the phones themselves; model or brand cannot be read from the photos.
The seller claims 'Direct mint Canada used iPhone 12 64GB with great battery health'.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model text on the phones; the design matches iPhone 12, but model and storage cannot be confirmed from photos. 'Direct mint Canada' is unverifiable_remote.
No screen or diagnostic data shown; battery health cannot be assessed remotely.

risks.risk: Phone is not an iPhone 12 or is a different model
risks.proof: Clear photo of the back showing the model name or a front view showing the screen and bezels.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used smartphone, not an iPhone 12

risks.risk: Battery health is poor or degraded
risks.proof: Screenshot of battery health from Settings > Battery > Battery Health (or equivalent) showing percentage and condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with degraded battery

risks.risk: Phone has physical damage or screen issues
risks.proof: Full front and back photos showing screen, bezels, and body without stickers or obstructions.
risks.if_unproven: priced with assumption of damage or screen issues

risks.risk: Phone is locked, blacklisted, or not functional
risks.proof: Video or photo of the phone turning on, showing home screen, and responding to touch.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the front screen showing the home screen or settings.
Photo of the back with the sticker removed or showing the model name.
Screenshot of battery health from the phone's settings.
Video of the phone turning on and operating normally.
response.reason: The phones appear to be iPhone 12s based on design, but model, storage, and battery health cannot be confirmed from the photos. Key risks like functionality, battery condition, and physical damage are unproven. Proof is needed to price accurately.
